cards.title: Communication of Uncertainty to Non-Modelers
cards.claim: Effective communication of uncertainty requires translating complex probabilistic outputs into accessible formats, such as cumulative probability plots combined with verbal quantifiers (e.g., 'likely', 'unlikely'). This approach helps non-modeling stakeholders (medicinal chemists, bioscientists) understand risk and make informed decisions without being overwhelmed by technical jargon.
conditions: Target audience includes non-experts in PK/PD modeling.
Focus on 'need-to-know' science rather than exhaustive technical detail.
required_inputs: Output distributions from Monte Carlo simulations.
Clear definitions of verbal quantifiers mapped to probability thresholds.
limitations: Risk of misinterpretation if the distinction between uncertainty and variability is not maintained in the visual language.
Sensitivity plots (one-at-a-time) are limited compared to integrated probabilistic analyses.
cards.downstream_use: Facilitates cross-functional decision-making in drug discovery projects by making uncertainty tangible and actionable.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
